changeSet.author: nexus-3wh8d.7
changeSet.comment: RDR-225 migration steps 2 to 7.8 in one transaction: partitions nexus.chunks and nexus.taxonomy_centroids by embedding_model then tenant_id; adds embedding_model to the three referencing tables; swaps the tables, foreign keys, views, policies and grants; attaches the service_tokens tenant-partition trigger; redefines every chunk write site and the manifest triggers. Also holds the step-2 objects of nexus-3wh8d.7: UNIQUE (tenant_id, name, embedding_model) on catalog_collections, the partition naming function, create_model_partition and create_tenant_partitions with their helpers. DATA EFFECT: rewrites every row of nexus.chunks and nexus.taxonomy_centroids into partitioned replacements (the old tables are kept as chunks_retired_225 and taxonomy_centroids_retired_225 for 14 days) and backfills embedding_model on catalog_document_chunks, topic_assignments and chunk_orphaned_at; a row whose vector dimension disagrees with its collection's model fails the walk and rolls it back. Irreversible in place after commit (cloud recovery is PITR; the rollback element restores the retired tables and discards writes made since). RDR-225 / nexus-3wh8d.7, nexus-3wh8d.8.
